sources.snippet: With the subsequent release of Llama 3.2, we have introduced new lightweight models in 1B and 3B and also multimodal models in 11B and 90B. The first few sections of this page-- Prompt Template, Base Model Prompt, and Instruct Model Prompt --are applicable across all the models released in both Llama 3.1 and Llama 3.2.
